No, there is no time interval of more than three days between LiHua initially asking Adam if he can buy a small fridge for the basement and Adam asking about the size of the fridge. The conversation regarding the fridge took place on consecutive days as shown in the timeline:

- November 10th, 2026 at 11:00 AM, LiHua asks Adam if it would be okay for her to get a small fridge for the basement.
- November 23rd, 2026 at 11:00 PM, Adam informs LiHua that the fridge will be delivered the following day at 4:00 PM.

Thus, the timeframe between these two exchanges is less than three days.
